content:
inc-bot: ALERT: Canary errors spike in eu-west-1 on /v1/generate. 5xx rate 12% over 3m (threshold 2%). auto-page: @sre-oncall

maya: on it, joining call. Can anyone confirm this is the blue->green rollout?

anya: yes, we started EU canary at 23:05 UTC, weight=10%. saw a small bump at 23:08 then big spike at 23:22.

devon: copying prometheus graphs — latency p95 up from 120ms -> 650ms for canary nodes, and 502 responses from proxy upstream.

alex: quick check: I can see 502s with header x-proxy-region: eu-west-1 and backend hints show `model-infer-02` returning "502 Bad Gateway" in logs.

maya: paging SRE oncall for mitigation. @sre-oncall please advise if we should kill the flag or rollback weights.

sre-oncall: joining. Oncall here (sre-oncall). Can you reproduce with a direct request to canary instances?

devon: running probe:
```
curl -i https://eu-west-1.api.redwood-inference.com/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer redacted' -d '{"prompt":"hi","max_tokens":10}'
```
returns a 502 and body: `{"error":"upstream timeout"}` from proxy.

maya: looks like proxy -> model pool handshake failing intermittently. Any recent config push?

anya: we flipped `proxy/keepalive` change at 23:01 earlier (small timeout tweak) as part of perf tweak for the canary. Could be related.

alex: also noticing DNS TTL for some edge proxies still honoring old upstream ip sets. `dig +trace` shows mixed A records for eu-west-1: some IPs are old weights for blue. TTLs were 300s but some caches sticky at 3600s due to intermediary.

maya: ok two possible vectors: kernel/proxy change causing 502s OR stale DNS leading to cross-region or mismatched backend sets. Need immediate mitigation to stop customer impact. What's impact right now? anyone on support?

anya: support says ~18 customers reported elevated error rates in EU since 23:20. Most are retrying but space for SLA blips.

sre-oncall: mitigation plan: 1) Pause canary traffic (set rollout weight=0) 2) Kill new proxy keepalive flag if pause incomplete 3) Clear edge DNS caches where possible / lower weight to previous IP set.

maya: agree. I'm going to set rollout weight to 0 now.

maya: `rdctl rollout set --region eu-west-1 --deployment canary --weight 0 && rdctl rollout status --region eu-west-1`

deploy-bot: action accepted: rollout weight set to 0 for canary eu-west-1 by maya at 23:29:15 UTC. New traffic should drain from canary within configured drain-time 60s.

devon: metrics: error rate dropping in 60s window. p95 latency trending down. Good signal.

alex: parallel: I'm going to toggle the internal perf flag back off. Command: `flagsctl set proxy.keepalive.enable false --env prod --region eu-west-1`

deploy-bot: feature flag changed: proxy.keepalive.enable=false by alex at 23:30:02 UTC.

nya? (typo)

anya: also opened a ticket for DNS ops — asking edge CDN to flush eu-west-1 DNS cache for our hostnames. I've included ASNs and zone ids.

sre-oncall: confirm rollback done and flag off. Let's keep canary at 0 for 30 minutes and monitor. If stable, we can attempt a safer re-roll with lower risk settings.

maya: posterity notes: probable root cause combo: keepalive tweak + sticky DNS TTL at intermediary resulted in a subset of proxies connecting to mismatched model pool that didn't accept new conn settings -> return 502s. More investigation required in model side.

devon: capturing logs: `grep 502 /var/log/proxy/* | tail -n 50` shows same stacktrace: `upstream read timeout` and `unexpected connection reset` from worker 6 on model-infer-02. Filing issue #INC-2025 for model team.

alex: customer impact: ~12 customers impacted with transient 5xx, no data exfiltration, brief SLA exposure. Notifying trust team now.

anya: trust-notify: drafted email to affected customers with summary and ETA for full RCA.

sre-oncall: monitoring for 10m windows. If no regression, we mark P1->P2 after 30m. Keep this channel for coordination.

maya: thanks all. I'll run a controlled redeploy of proxy (revert keepalive patch) into a single az tomorrow morning and run canary again with 1% weight and extended drain times.

devon: oncall handoff note: @sre-oncall will be primary until 00:30 UTC, then hand off to @maya for follow-up.

sre-oncall: acknowledged handoff. leaving active watch and pager routing.

maya: closing action list: rollback weight (done), flag off (done), dns flush requested (pending), model team ticket created (INC-2025), customer comms draft (anya).

maya: marking thread resolved for immediate mitigation. Will update when RCA available. :white_check_mark:
